reason: Descriptive workplace-wellness cohort reports body composition, fitness, and a generic 'biological age' but no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin measurement.
DNA-methylation-based epigenetic clocks (extrinsic, intrinsic, Grim, DunedinPoAm) measured in blood distinguish treated breast-cancer survivors from matched controls for survivorship monitoring.
Phase I panobinostat trial in pediatric DIPG reports toxicity, MTD, and survival endpoints without measuring any epigenetic marker.
FOXO3/FOXM1/SIRT6 are assessed by immunohistochemistry; DNA methylation is only inferred from cBioportal/MEXPRESS database lookups, not directly measured in the trial samples.
Differentially methylated CpG sites from individual-level TCGA LUAD data feed a multi-omics classifier predicting tumor mutation burden to guide immunotherapy selection.
Telaglenastat/azacytidine MDS trial reports scRNAseq, flow cytometry, and SLC38A1 expression correlates, not a measured methylation or histone mark.
Genome-wide DNA methylation of the CD95L promoter (CpG2) was measured in glioblastoma trial patients and differentiates Asunercept responders from non-responders.
CXCL12 promoter/gene-body CpG methylation analyzed from individual-level TCGA data via UALCAN/MethSurv is linked to bladder-cancer prognosis and immunotherapy responsiveness.
DNA-methylation-based molecular subtyping within the ACNS0334 RCT determined which subgroup (Group 3) benefited from added methotrexate, a treatment-selection link.
SASP circulating-protein panel is tested against biological age and surgical outcomes; no epigenetic marker is assayed.
Circulating senescence-associated secretome proteins are profiled as biomarkers; no DNA methylation or histone modification is measured.

MKRN3 and DLK1/MEG3 differentially methylated region methylation index was measured by bisulfite qPCR in CPP patients and compared with pubertal controls, informing diagnosis of an imprinting disorder.
Leucocyte telomere length is the outcome measured in this UK Biobank walking-pace study; telomere length is not one of the eligible epigenetic marker categories.
Muscle-integrity imaging and biological-age modeling are performed entirely in Caenorhabditis elegans, with no human participants or human-derived samples.
Histone H2A and H2B are identified as plasma iTRAQ/PRM proteomic biomarkers of gout, a circulating-protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
A DNA-methylation classifier (MIMIC) was applied to frozen tumor tissue from a national pediatric medulloblastoma cohort as a diagnostic comparison against immunohistochemical subgrouping.
Belinostat-plus-chemoradiation glioblastoma trial reports recurrence volumes and survival without measuring any epigenetic marker.
Bisulfite sequencing PCR directly measured NIS and TIMP-3 promoter methylation in a cross-sectional series of thyroid cancer and goiter tissue for diagnostic differentiation.
Establishment and multi-omic characterization of a 224-line pediatric cancer cell-line resource/atlas is a technical resource paper, not one of the five eligible clinical designs.
Illumina 450K DNA methylation profiling of a prospectively assembled adult ependymoma cohort defines molecular subgroups linked to recurrence-risk stratification.
Retrospective DNA-methylation-based classification of tumors from the prospective, population-based E-HIT trial cohort is tied to treatment-stratum survival outcomes.
Retrospective DNA methylation profiling within the ACNS0332 phase 3 RCT reclassified CNS-PNET/pineoblastoma diagnoses and revealed divergent outcomes by true diagnosis.
A MethylMix-derived methylation signature built from individual-level TCGA/GTEx/ICGC pancreatic cancer data is validated against overall survival and combined into a prognostic nomogram.
TMEFF2 promoter methylation, assessed by BSAS/MSP in glioma cell lines and via TCGA cohort analysis, is associated with IDH/ATRX/TP53 subtype and prognosis in glioma patients.
Single-cell/nucleus RNA-sequencing characterization of ependymoma references previously reported DNA methylation subgroups but does not itself measure a methylation or histone marker.
Genome-wide promoter-CpG methylation (450K array) was profiled in a discovery low-grade glioma cohort and validated in TCGA, associating with overall survival.
Hannum, Horvath, and Levine DNAm epigenetic clocks were measured in whole blood across a multi-cohort schizophrenia case-control sample, informing mortality-risk biomarker use.
5-hydroxymethylcytosine profiling of plasma cell-free DNA was directly measured in a case-control pancreatic cancer early-detection study.
UK Biobank light-exposure and blood-pressure analysis cites 'biological age' as a mediator without describing measurement of any DNA methylation, histone, or chromatin marker.
Loss of H3K27 trimethylation was assessed by immunostaining in stereotactic biopsies from the BIOMEDE trial and used alongside PTEN/EGFR status for treatment-allocation biomarker screening.
Transposable-element and IKZF1 transcript expression are measured by transcriptomics in sarcoma biopsies; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state assay is reported.
A DNA-methylation-based meningioma classifier (Methylation Classes) built from a reference cohort was applied diagnostically to over 200 clinical cases to guide grading and treatment decisions.
Genome-wide differential blood DNA methylation was identified in sporadic Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease patients and replicated in a second cohort, distinct from Alzheimer's and inherited prion disease.
Ultralow-risk breast tumors are characterized by the 70-gene expression signature and multi-gene expression modules; no epigenetic mark is directly measured.
Pyrosequencing measured AGT promoter methylation at four CpG sites in glioblastoma tumor tissue, predicting bevacizumab non-response in training and validation cohorts.
Infinium EPIC DNA methylation profiling of FFPE tumors from a multi-institutional Hong Kong pediatric CNS tumor cohort supported diagnostic reclassification.
DNA-methylation-based tumor classification within a German HIT-MED registry cohort of metastatic medulloblastoma is associated with chemotherapy response.
The prospective MNP 2.0 study performed DNA methylation-based classification on over 1,000 pediatric CNS tumors for routine diagnostic use.
A single adult diffuse midline glioma patient treated with olaparib plus bevacizumab is reported as a case report.
ZNF133/KAP1 repression of L1CAM is investigated by ChIP-seq and immunohistochemistry of protein expression in breast cancer tissue; no epigenetic mark measurement is reported in patient samples.
Klemera-Doubal, homeostatic dysregulation, and Levine biological-age algorithms are built from routine clinical biomarkers in the Duke-EPESE cohort, not an epigenetic marker.
Adult medulloblastoma cohort profiling uses targeted mutation sequencing and Nanostring-based subgrouping; no methylation or histone assay is described.
The MARK-AGE biomarker panel described here comprises cellular proteins, miRNA, and mRNA; miRNA is the only epigenetic-adjacent marker named and it is non-coding RNA.
H3K27me3 histone modification was measured by mass spectrometry, ChIP-sequencing, and immunohistochemistry across pediatric ependymoma cohorts, distinguishing PFA from PFB for prognosis.
Chromatin modification maps generated from pre-treatment melanoma biopsies identify enhancer states that predict response to anti-PD-1 therapy.

snATAC-seq chromatin accessibility was profiled in melanoma patient samples, but the abstract does not make clear whether this epigenomic marker itself, versus immune cell-type composition, is what predicts treatment outcome.
Plasma histone-bound DNA is used as a circulating neutrophil extracellular trap biomarker in influenza, a protein/DNA-complex assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Leukocyte and buccal-cell DNA methylation of colon-cancer risk genes was measured directly in a longitudinal cohort and in a randomized physical-activity intervention trial.
Confocal detection of cell-free chromatin particles via anti-DNA/anti-histone immunostaining is a structural chromatin-fragment assay, not a measured DNA methylation or histone-modification state.
Pineoblastoma single-nucleus RNA-sequencing study builds on previously reported DNA methylation subgroups without measuring a marker itself.
DNA methylation profiling subclassified infant medulloblastoma within the prospective SJYC07 phase II trial, shaping the radiation-sparing risk stratification.
DNA methylation confirmed SHH subgroup assignment in a retrospective cohort of Li-Fraumeni-syndrome medulloblastoma patients whose treatment sequence was linked to outcomes.
A randomized ascorbate-infusion colon-cancer trial measures tumor ascorbate levels and hypoxia-associated proteins, not an epigenetic marker.
A DNA-methylation-based surrogate marker of C-reactive protein (DNAm CRP) was measured in blood across two cohorts and linked to brain-ageing phenotypes in depression.
Retrospective DNA methylation profiling within the ACNS0332 phase 3 trial reclassified pediatric embryonal tumor/pineoblastoma diagnoses and revealed large survival differences by true diagnosis.
KDM-BA and Mahalanobis-distance physiological-dysregulation aging measures are derived from 12 routine clinical biomarkers, not an epigenetic assay.
Differentially methylated CpGs and regions measured in lung adenocarcinoma tumor tissue and circulating tumor DNA predict brain-metastasis development independent of stage.
Infinium 450K DNA methylation profiling across 705 cancer patients identified phosphatase-promoter epimutations associated with patient survival and treatment sensitivity.
Sanger-sequenced CpG methylation at the MGMT promoter was measured in a retrospective cohort of WHO grade II glioma and was prognostic for survival.
APC gene mutation status, not an epigenetic mark, is correlated with PD-L1 expression and tumor mutational burden in endometrial cancer despite APC's chromatin-remodeling function.
EZH2 exon 16 point mutation detected by Sanger sequencing and ddPCR in tumor and circulating tumor DNA is a genetic variant, not a measured histone modification.
A DNA methylation episignature was measured in blood from ASXL1-mutant Bohring-Opitz syndrome patients versus controls, plus secondary TCGA AML methylation data, to inform diagnostic classification.
Illumina 450K methylation array profiling of tumor tissue from the HERBY phase II RCT subtyped pediatric high-grade glioma with prognostic significance.
Histone H3 is reported as one of several upregulated serum exosomal proteins in heat stroke, a circulating-protein assay rather than a chromatin measurement.
Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma genomic landscape is characterized by NGS mutation calling; chromatin-remodeling genes are named only as a mutated pathway category, not an assayed epigenetic mark.
DNA methylation variance measured in a human cohort prenatally exposed to the Dutch Famine tests an epigenetic-selection mechanism linking a maternal-adversity exposure to methylation outcomes.

Genome-wide promoter hypomethylation is described as inferred through systems-level transcriptional network analysis, and it is not clear whether methylation itself was directly assayed in the breast cancer samples.
Whole-methylome profiling performed within the randomized ARTE trial identified a methylation subtype (RTK I) associated with differential bevacizumab benefit in elderly glioblastoma.
EZH2 codon 641 mutation detected in circulating tumor DNA by Sanger sequencing/ddPCR is a genetic marker, not a measured epigenetic mark.
The eyeAge retinal aging clock is derived from deep-learning analysis of fundus images, not from DNA methylation or another eligible epigenetic marker.
DNA methylation array analysis confirmed MN1 rearrangement diagnostically and characterized microRNA-promoter methylation in a cohort of astroblastoma tumors compared with normal brain tissue.
Characterization and drug/CRISPR screening of 23 atypical teratoid rhabdoid tumor cell lines is a cell-line resource study, not one of the five eligible clinical designs.

Histone serotonylation changes in ZFTA-RELA ependymoma are explored mechanistically across human tissue and a mouse in-utero-electroporation tumor model, without a defined epidemiological comparison design.
SRAVANA is a study protocol describing planned DNA methylation and stress-response measurements in Indian birth cohorts; no primary data are yet reported.
This thesis summary of lymphoma biomarker trials describes protein biomarkers (HR23B, c-MYC) rather than a measured DNA methylation or histone mark.
A DNA-methylation-based molecular subclass (RTKI/RTKII/Mesenchymal) was assigned in a retrospective IDH-wildtype glioblastoma cohort and tested against hyperglycemia-related survival.
Single-cell RNA-sequencing characterization of pediatric ependymoma references known DNA methylation subgroups without measuring methylation in this study.
5-hydroxymethylcytosine profiling of plasma cell-free DNA was measured across multiple cancer case-control cohorts (breast, lung, prostate, pancreatic) for early detection.
An updated DNA-methylation-based CNS tumor classifier was benchmarked by cross-validation and an independent diagnostic cohort of human tumor samples.
A weathering/biological-age index built from clinical biomarkers is examined against cognition in an atrial fibrillation cohort; no epigenetic marker is described.
DNA methylation profiling defined a novel PLAGL1/PLAGL2-amplified pediatric CNS tumor entity as epigenetically distinct from known molecular tumor classes.
RNA-sequencing-based gene-fusion detection is this study's focus; DNA methylation array data is used only incidentally for breakpoint comparison rather than as the assessed marker.
DNA methylation array profiling of matched diagnostic and relapse medulloblastoma samples from 126 patients characterizes subgroup conservation and divergence at relapse.
Illumina 450K methylation profiling in a discovery cohort and TCGA validation cohort of low-grade glioma defines a prognostic intra-tumor methylation-heterogeneity score.

SCT promoter hypermethylation, measured by quantitative methylation-specific PCR and confirmed in individual-level TCGA lung tumor data versus non-cancerous tissue, is proposed as a diagnostic biomarker.
Droplet digital PCR detection of the H3K27M mutation in cerebrospinal fluid and plasma ctDNA tracks a genetic variant rather than measuring histone modification status.
MRI-derived brain age is the aging phenotype used in this Puerto Rican cohort study; no DNA methylation or histone marker is assayed.
Retrospective DNA-methylation-based classification of infant intracranial ependymoma from a German registry cohort informed the radiotherapy timing decision.
850k EPIC methylation-class assignment in a retrospective meningioma cohort was combined with mutation panel data to predict progression-free survival.
MGMT promoter methylation measured by pyrosequencing across a large glioma cohort, alongside H3.3/H3.1 mutation status, informs prognostic molecular subtyping.
ATRX/DAXX gene and protein expression and telomere length are assessed in pediatric adrenocortical tumors; none is an eligible DNA methylation, histone, or chromatin marker.
Post-zygotic 11p15.5 hypermethylation (loss of imprinting) was measured in a retrospective cohort of bilateral Wilms tumor patients and informs treatment-relevant biomarker development.
DNA methylation array profiling combined with RNA-seq classified 52 childhood medulloblastoma tumors by molecular subgroup to inform personalized care.
Retrospective DNA methylation and exome profiling within a phase 3 high-risk medulloblastoma RCT identified molecular subgroups associated with carboplatin benefit.

SDC2/TFPI2 promoter methylation status, analyzed from individual-level TCGA/GEO data and validated in a custom patient cohort, defines colorectal cancer methylator phenotypes for biomarker development.
SALL4 promoter demethylation is characterized in K562/HL-60 leukemic cell lines, while MDS patient bone-marrow samples are assessed only for SALL4 expression change, not methylation itself.
In silico modeling of DIPG driver mutations for drug repurposing uses mutational genomics and transcriptomics from patient data; no epigenetic marker is directly measured.
The Petechiae in Children study evaluates meningococcal disease clinical decision rules using blood culture and PCR testing, with no epigenetic content.

H3K27 trimethylation and H2BK120 deubiquitination are studied mechanistically in melanoma cell lines and mouse models, while patient-tissue correlation is limited to USP7/EZH2 protein expression by immunohistochemistry.
A descriptive case series of 25 small-for-gestational-age children with hypospadias undergoing molecular workup, including 11p15 methylation testing, has no comparison group.
